items.title: Tuesday, August 11th, 2026
items.summary: # I looked down at my watch earlier to see a crack right across the glass 😱 I don't even remember bashing it at any point this morning. Luckily, on inspection, it was the protector I'd put on and not the watch itself. 😅 I was worried as I couldn't feel the crack at all. At least the protector did its job.
